camel_example: aliyun ecs ImportKeyPair --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairName testKeyPairName --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PublicKeyBody ABC1234567
description_en: Imports the public key of an RSA key pair generated by another tool. After you import the key pair, Alibaba Cloud stores the public key. You must store the private key on your own
description_zh: 导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分。导入密钥对后，阿里云为您保管公钥部分，您需要自行妥善保存密钥对的私钥部分
kebab_example: aliyun ecs import-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --public-key-body ABC1234567 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter, either uppercase or lowercase, or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain characters that are classified as letters in Unicode, including letters, Chinese characters, and digits. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https:// 开头。支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The public key of the key pair
parameters.name: public_key_body

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the SSH key pair belongs
parameters.help_zh: SSH密钥对所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 密钥对的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The public key fingerprint format is defined in RFC 4716 and uses the MD5 message digest algorithm
KeyPairFingerPrint.description_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC 4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair
